integrity: The proof supplies the all-horizon conditional parity attenuation, geometric-holding sparsity argument, non-identically distributed Kolmogorov iterated-logarithm application, Fubini transfer and martingale functional limit. Exact finite computations are supplementary and do not certify the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem requires independent Bernoulli coefficients across time and cardinality, with probabilities uniformly bounded away from zero and one. It is an almost-every-environment statement, not a theorem for every deterministic environment. It does not resolve time-constant or temporally dependent transformations, nor finite-sample normal approximation.
title: A quenched law of the iterated logarithm for cardinality-grouped bootstrap walks
